sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Hiren Sharma, M
 Kait & Mr. Nav
 versus
 State Nct Of Delhi 
 Through: Ms. Richa Dhawan, A

CORAM:
 HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA  ORDER % 14.08.2024 CRL.M.A. 24203/2024 (Exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

3. The present Petition under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed on behalf of the petitioner seeking interim bail on medical grounds for a period of two months in FIR No. 14/2022 registered under Sections 406/467/468/471/420/120B of the Indian Penal Code at Police Station Special Cell, Delhi.
5. Ms. Richa Dhawan, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on advance notice, accepts notice on behalf of the State and seeks time to verify the medical documents of the petitioner.
6. The Status Report be filed within 5 days.

7. List for arguments on 20.08.2024.
NEENA BANSAL KRISHNA, J AUGUST 14, 2024/S.Sharma
